title: Ground radar finds debris field and voids in mesa

tellings.quote: there's there's both a debris field of material that does not fit, that is um unusual,

plain: The owner of Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property long known for reports of strange events, says ground-penetrating radar on a mesa there found hollow spaces underground and "a debris field of material that does not fit, that is unusual." The owner tells Michels this as someone directly involved in the work. The episode's title frames it as a sign that something, perhaps a craft, lies buried under the ranch.
